annotation.bound_parties_text: The vehicle manufacturer or its authorized representative applying for type approval, who must demonstrate compliance to the Technical Service, and the Contracting Parties/type approval authorities that grant and communicate approvals.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The application for approval of a vehicle type with regard to the ALKS shall be submitted by the vehicle manufacturer or by the manufacturer’s authorized representative.
annotation.dates_quote: Date of entry into force: 22 January 2021
annotation.robot_provision_quote: UN Regulation No 157 – Uniform provisions concerning the approval of vehicles with regards to Automated Lane Keeping Systems [2021/389]
